title: Setting Snowsports School Credit Against What a Household Owes
content:
School credit standing on a Snowsports School booking, being the credit issued on it less the credit already applied from it, is set against the figure owed and money is taken only for what is left.

**Clause 1.** The amount collected is settled only after the school account carries the credit entry owed for every session the collective could not run.

**Clause 2 — what counts toward the credit standing.** Credit issued longer ago than the product's credit validity period, counted in whole months of thirty days from the day of issue, has run out and no longer counts toward the credit standing. Where several credit entries stand they are counted together, the entry closest to running out being the first spent.

**Clause 3 — how much is set against the figure owed.** Where the credit standing is at or above the product's minimum redemption and falls short of the figure owed, the whole of the credit standing is set against the figure owed and the remainder is collected. Where the credit standing is at or above the product's minimum redemption and is at or above the figure owed, only as much of the credit as the figure owed is set against it and nothing further is collected. Where the credit standing falls below the product's minimum redemption, no credit is set against the figure owed, the amount set against standing at 0.00 USD, and the whole of it is collected.

## The validity periods and minimum redemptions the clauses turn on

| Product | Credit validity (calendar days) | Minimum redemption (USD) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| All-Mountain Adult Group Lesson | 180 | 25.00 |
| Mountain Explorers Group Lesson | 180 | 25.00 |
| Mountain Cubs Group Lesson | 180 | 25.00 |
| Six-Week Development Programme | 365 | 50.00 |
| Semi-Private Coaching Session | 270 | 50.00 |
| Private Instruction Full Day | 270 | 50.00 |
| Elite Performance Camp | 365 | 100.00 |

Counted in whole months of thirty days, a validity of 180 calendar days is six such months, 270 is nine and 365 is twelve full months with five days over, so an entry issued more than twelve such months before the handling date has run out on a product carrying 365 days.

## Clause 3 set out on both sides of each boundary

| Credit standing | Against a figure owed of 400.00 USD, on a product whose minimum redemption is 50.00 USD | Set against | Collected |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 49.00 USD | below the minimum | 0.00 USD | 400.00 USD |
| 50.00 USD | at the minimum, short of the figure owed | 50.00 USD | 350.00 USD |
| 399.00 USD | above the minimum, short of the figure owed | 399.00 USD | 1.00 USD |
| 400.00 USD | above the minimum, at the figure owed | 400.00 USD | nothing |
| 620.00 USD | above the minimum, above the figure owed | 400.00 USD | nothing |

Where two credit entries stand on a booking, one of 30.00 USD issued in November and one of 90.00 USD issued in January, and neither has run out, the credit standing is 120.00 USD and the November entry is spent before the January one.
